{"id":1572568474,"question_id":3643,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 4 months","timestamp":1741877240,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1572568474/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Zero Array Transformation II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minZeroArray(vector<int>& nums, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<queries.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            int start = queries[i][0];\n            int end = queries[i][1];\n            int value = queries[i][2];\n\n            for(int j= start ; j<=end ; j++)\n            {\n                nums[j] -= value;\n                if(nums[j] < 0) \n                    nums[j]=0;\n            }\n            int count = 0;\n            for(int k= 0 ; k<nums.size(); k++)\n            {\n                if(nums[k] == 0)\n                count++;\n            }\n            if(count == nums.size())\n            return i+1;\n        }\n        return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"zero-array-transformation-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":429}
